name: voidmob
description: Receive SMS verification codes for your own accounts on real US non-VoIP numbers, keep a dedicated number, buy eSIM data for travel, and use 4G/5G mobile IPs by country, paid from a prepaid VoidMob balance.

settings.name: VoidMob API key
settings.description: Your vmk_live_... key from https://dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys. It can spend your prepaid balance. Leave empty with sandbox mode on.

settings.name: Sandbox mode
settings.description: 1 = offline mock data with a $500 play balance, nothing is charged. Leave empty for live mode.

settings.name: Read-only
settings.description: 1 = hide every tool that spends money or changes anything. Leave empty to allow purchases.

settings.name: Max per order (US cents)
settings.description: Refuse any single purchase above this many whole US cents (2500 = $25.00). Leave empty for no limit.

settings.name: Session budget (US cents)
settings.description: Stop buying once this many whole US cents were spent since the server started (5000 = $50.00). Leave empty for no budget.
